BOH.why: During busy service, he went above and beyond by helping with additional food preparation, including peeling prawns and preparing broth, while also supporting the team with organising deliveries. He showed great initiative by stepping in wherever help was needed, helping the kitchen stay prepared, organised and ready to handle high customer volumes.

answers.How well does this employee manage their: He manages his time well by staying on top of essential kitchen tasks, including peeling eggs and washing pots, helping to keep the kitchen organised, clean and running smoothly during busy periods.
answers.Describe a time when this employee demon: He consistently completes tasks such as peeling eggs, sorting out delivery and pot washing efficiently, even during busy periods. His ability to work at a good pace while keeping the kitchen organised helps the team maintain a smooth workflow and support daily. operations.
answers.In what other ways does this employee co: He demonstrates great teamwork and initiative by independently helping the kitchen organise deliveries, peeling prawns and preparing broth when the kitchen is packed. He is always willing to step in and support the team wherever needed, helping to keep operations running smoothly during busy periods. His positive attitude and willingness to take on additional responsibilities make him a valuable member of the kitchen team.
answers.Provide an example of when this employee: During busy service, he went above and beyond by helping with additional food preparation, including peeling prawns and preparing broth, while also supporting the team with organising deliveries. He showed great initiative by stepping in wherever help was needed, helping the kitchen stay prepared, organised and ready to handle high customer volumes.
answers.Describe a time when this employee showe: He consistently shows a strong work ethic by taking the initiative to help with tasks without needing to be asked, especially during busy services. Whether organising deliveries, peeling prawns, preparing broth or helping with general kitchen duties, he is always willing to step in and support the team to ensure the kitchen runs smoothly.
answers.Has this employee shown any notable impr: He has shown consistent improvement over the past month, particularly in the speed and efficiency of peeling eggs and washing pots. He is becoming more confident and effective in completing his daily responsibilities, demonstrating a positive attitude towards learning and developing his skills.
answers.What makes this employee’s performance s: He's a very hardworking guy, always trying to support the kitchen whenever needed and didn't have any complaints about his work.
